Om Parkash Bansal And Another vs State Of Punjab And Others
on 12 March, 2025
In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana

At Chandigarh
124
Cwp No.3149 of 2025
Date Of Decision : 12 March, 2025

Om Parkash Bansal & another
.... Petitioners

Versus
State of Punjab & others
.... Respondents
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Tiwari

Ok Ok 
Present: | Mr. Akshay Bhan, Senior Advocate with
Mr. Aman Bansal, Advocate for the petitioner.

Mr. Pardeep Bajaj, Dag, Punjab with
Asi Jaswinder Singh, Ps Chamkaur Sahib.
Mr. Pawandeep Singh, Advocate for respondents No.5 & 6.
3 Ok Ok Ok
Kuldeep Tiwari J. (Oral)
1.

Through the instant writ petition filed under Article 226/227 of the Constitution of India, a prayer is made for quashing the orders dated 21.06.2023 (Annexure P-4) and 22.02.2024 (Annexure P-5)
passed by respondent No.2, where through the inquiry has been initiated and caused grievance to the petitioners and compel them to approach this Court by casting the present petition.
2.

Though forcibly refuted the submissions made by learned Senior counsel for the petitioners, the learned State counsel on instructions has submitted that, in fact, it is not a case of multiple inquiries, rather investigation is going on in the FIR No.44 dated 16.05.2023 (Annexure P-1)
3.
The learned senior counsel for the petitioners submits that it is a case of multiple inquiries.

Finding merit in the submissions made by integrity of this document/judgment StS PHP OMY the learned senior counsel for the petitioners, this Court by drawing order dated 05.02.2025 directed the State to inform this court whether any inquiry is pending against the petitioners arising out of the FIR No.44 dated 16.05.2023 (Annexure P-1) registered under Sections 406, 420 & 120-B IPC at Police Station Chamkaur Sahib, District Ropar.

Thereupon the learned State counsel after having instructions from the quarter concerned informed this Court that the investigation report, after Om Parkash Bansal And Another vs State Of Punjab And Others on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69359307/

sentences.text: completion of the investigation, is now pending with the Director, Bureau of Investigation, Punjab and the final decision will be taken within 15 days.

The matter was adjourned for today to await the outcome of the decision taken by the Director, Bureau of Investigation (supra).
4.

Today, learned State counsel placed on record the affidavit of Sh. Sarbjit Singh, PPS, Assistant Inspector General, of Police, Litigation, Bureau of Investigation, Punjab to inform this court that the Bureau of Investigation has already taken the final decision and order for present of challan against Harinder Kaur, Jagdev Singh and Swaran Singh for commission of offences under Sections 406, 420 & 120-B of IPC to the competent Court.
The affidavit (supra) further voiced about that the matter is now under process with the District Police to file final report under Section 193 of BNSS, 2023 to Illaqa Magistrate concerned.
Further the learned State counsel submits that the Station House Officer concemed now within four weeks from today will submit the final report before the Illaqa Magistrate concerned.
RAJ KUMAR 2025.03.17 09:50 SU25 PHC Ue 5.
In view of the above undertaking given by the learned State counsel no further order is required to be passed by this Court.
Therefore, the instant petition is ordered to be closed.
6. Disposed of accordingly.
